limits: The original deployed application release remains sourceI; publicationL adds only the reviewed resolver correction and its proofs.
The controller verified live DNS and absence of any5355 TCP/UDP binding; the separate barriers observation measures TCP listeners and firewall declarations.
Authenticated application authorization, end-to-end SMTP, completed backup restoration, ViSe directory content preservation and future CI authority are not established by these checks.
Green is masked/inactive; periodic workers were idle when observed, so live process checks do not apply to those observations.
Previously observed resource counters with unavailable values are not reclassified as zero and no CI capacity approval is inferred.
scope: read-only independent review of closed production observations; no production action by reviewer
